definitions.explanation: a Japanese rice bowl dish consisting of chicken and egg simmered in a sweet soy-based sauce, served over rice

examples.japanese: ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{親子丼|おやこどん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{親子丼|おやこどん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Oyakodon is delicious when the egg is fluffy.

examples.japanese: {定食屋|ていしょくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{親子丼|おやこどん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered oyakodon at a set meal restaurant.

notes:
NAME ORIGIN:
⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parent) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) + {丼|どん} (rice bowl) → "parent and child bowl"
The name comes from the combination of chicken (parent) and egg (child).

INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧ (chicken)
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg)
- {玉|たま}ねぎ (onion)
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce)
- みりん (sweet cooking sake)
- ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (dashi broth)
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice)

COOKING TIP:
The egg should be slightly runny (⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧) for the best texture.

RELATED {丼|どんぶり} DISHES:
- ⟦カツ{丼|どん}→カツ丼：08539_katsudon⟧ (pork cutlet rice bowl)
- ⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧ (beef rice bowl)
- ⟦{天丼|てんどん}→天丼：19279_tendon⟧ (tempura rice bowl)
- {海鮮丼|かいせんどん} (seafood rice bowl)
